item.title: The Great Shift in Work and Learning… Now Is the Time for Institutions to Prevent an 'AI Atrocity' (일과 학습의 대전환…이젠 ‘AI 잔혹사’ 막을 제도의 시간)
item.description:
<<>> The People and Digital Forum, which discusses technology for humanity, will be held on the 24th of next month. The theme of this fifth edition is 'The AI Era: The Future of Work and Learning.' Domestic and international experts will gather to explore alternatives and solutions on how to respond to a time when generative artificial intelligence is reshaping jobs and disrupting traditional education. ()

Automated teller machines (ATMs) are considered a prime example of banking automation technology. When they were first widely introduced by Citibank in the United States in the 1970s, many predicted that the new technology would eliminate teller jobs. After all, ATMs could handle tasks that cost over $1 when done by a human employee for just 27 cents, a quarter of the cost. But these predictions were completely off the mark. Compared to the 1980s, the number of bank tellers in the U.S. actually increased in the early 2000s. By lowering branch operating costs, ATMs led banks to significantly expand their branch networks. The remaining tellers shifted from cash handling to relationship banking, focusing on building customer trust and introducing credit cards, loans, and investment products. In this way, automation complemented human labor, allowing jobs to be maintained and even expanded. ( 인간을 위한 기술을 논의하는 사람과디지털포럼이 다음 달 24일 열린다. 5회를 맞는 올해 주제는 ‘에이아이(AI)시대, 일과 학습의 미래’다. 생성형 인공지능이 일자리를 재편하고 기존 교육을 흔드는 시대에 어떻게 대응해야 하는지 국내외 전문가들이 모여 대안과 해법을 모색한다.)

The real decline in teller jobs began not with ATMs, but with the iPhone. After mobile banking became commonplace in the 2010s, the number of tellers fell by nearly 30%. This case shows that the relationship between automation and employment is by no means straightforward. The outcome depends on the context and the institutions under which the technology is introduced. ( 현금자동입출금기(ATM)는 대표적인 은행 업무 자동화 기술로 꼽힌다. 1970년대 미국 씨티은행에 의해 대규모로 도입되던 당시엔 많은 이들이 신기술로 인해 창구 직원 일자리가 사라질 것으로 전망했다. 직원이 처리하면 1달러가 넘게 드는 일을 현금자동입출금기는 4분의 1수준인 27센트로 해결할 수 있었던 탓이다. 하지만 예상은 완전히 빗나갔다. 1980년대에 견줘 2000년 초반 미국의 은행 창구 직원은 오히려 늘었다. 현금자동입출금기가 지점 운영 비용을 낮추자 은행들이 지점 수를 대폭 늘렸고, 남은 창구 직원들은 현금 업무 대신 고객과의 신뢰 형성, 신용카드 대출, 투자상품 등을 소개하는 관계 금융에 집중했다. 자동화가 인간 노동을 보완해 일자리가 유지·확장될 수 있었던 셈이다.)

Professor Carl Benedikt Frey of the University of Oxford, who will deliver the keynote speech at the 5th People and Digital Forum, is a globally renowned economist who emphasizes that whether AI increases or decreases jobs depends not on technology, but on institutions and political choices. His 2013 paper, which argued that 47% of U.S. jobs were at risk of automation, sparked widespread debate on the issue. At this forum, he plans to speak on the theme 'Designing the Future of Work in the AI Transition: Conditions for Good Jobs and Sustainable Progress.' He argues that in an era when human work is under threat, we must learn from history to properly grasp changes in work beyond anxiety and fear. ( 창구 직원의 본격적인 감소는 현금자동입출금기가 아닌 아이폰에서 비롯됐다. 2010년대 모바일 뱅킹이 일상화된 이후 창구 직원 수는 30% 가까이 줄었다. 자동화와 고용의 관계가 결코 단선적이지 않음을 보여주는 사례다. 기술이 어떤 맥락에서, 어떤 제도 아래 도입되느냐에 따라 그 결과도 달라진다.)

For example, the 18th and 19th century Industrial Revolution led to the industrialization of manufacturing across Britain, but not in France. The difference was shaped by political and social contexts and institutions, such as parliamentary democracy and the political power of the capitalist class. In Britain, despite fierce resistance like the Luddite movement, workers ultimately failed due to a lack of political power. As a result, British workers endured severe suffering, including job losses, for about 70 years before they could reap the benefits of the Industrial Revolution. In contrast, France's worker resistance protected jobs but delayed industrialization. Professor Frey emphasizes that the relationship between generative AI and jobs ultimately depends not on technology itself, but on human political choices like institutions and regulations, and on the distribution of power between those who benefit and those who suffer. He also argues that true progress is possible only when the benefits generated by technology are well-distributed, so that the pain of transition does not fall excessively on any particular group. (제5회 사람과디지털포럼의 기조강연을 맡은 칼 베네딕트 프레이 영국 옥스퍼드대 교수는 인공지능이 일자리를 늘릴지 줄일지는 기술이 아닌 제도와 정치적 선택에 달려있다고 강조하는 세계적 경제학자다. 2013년 미국 직업의 47%가 자동화 위험에 처해 있다는 논문으로 자동화에 따른 일자리 논쟁을 촉발한 바 있다. 이번 포럼에서는 ‘인공지능 전환기, 일의 미래 어떻게 설계할 것인가 : 좋은 일자리와 지속가능한 진보의 조건’을 주제로 강연할 예정이다. 인간의 일이 위협받고 있는 시대, 불안과 공포를 넘어 일의 변화를 제대로 포착하기 위해서는 역사 속에서 교훈을 얻어야 한다고 말한다.)

The second keynote speech, titled 'The AI Transition and Deepening Inequality: Who Bears the Burden and How Should We Share It?' will be given by Sarah O'Connor, Deputy Editor of the UK's Financial Times. Drawing on her firsthand reporting from the front lines of technological change—such as translators who have been reduced to editing AI translations, logistics warehouse workers surrounded by robots, and university graduates applying for jobs interviewed by software—she delves deep into the transformation of 'job quality.' Her questions include: Are machines not merely taking over people's jobs, but are workers being inserted into machine systems? And are fundamental concepts like fairness, merit, and humanity being redefined within those systems (algorithms)? Deputy Editor O'Connor seeks alternatives to counter algorithms from the history of resistance by workers who fought for more human working conditions against machines, from 19th-century British cotton mill workers to 21st-century Swedish miners. ( 예컨대 18~19세기 산업혁명은 영국에서 제조업 전반의 산업화로 이어졌지만, 프랑스에서는 그렇지 않았다. 이 차이를 가른 것은 의회 민주주의, 자본가 계급의 정치력 등 정치·사회적 맥락과 제도였다. 영국에서도 러다이트 운동처럼 격렬한 저항이 있었지만, 결국 정치적 힘의 부재로 실패했다. 그 댓가로 영국의 노동자들은 산업혁명의 혜택을 누리기까지, 약 70년 동안 일자리 상실 등 처절한 고통을 감내했다. 이와 달리 프랑스는 노동자의 저항으로 일자리를 지킨 대신 산업화가 지연됐다. 프레이 교수는 생성형 인공지능과 일자리의 관계도 결국 기술 그 자체가 아니라 제도·규제와 같은 인간의 정치적 선택, 이익을 보는 쪽과 고통을 당하는 쪽 사이의 권력 배분에 달려있다고 강조한다. 아울러 전환 과정에서 특정 집단에게 고통이 집중되지 않도록 기술이 창출하는 이익을 잘 분배할 때 진정한 발전도 가능하다고 말한다.)

In the roundtable following the keynote speeches, Lee Sang-heon, Senior Economist at the International Labour Organization (ILO), will serve as moderator for a lively discussion on the theme 'Rewriting the Rules of the AI Transition: Designing Institutions and Solidarity.' Participants will share national experiences and explore alternatives on how to distribute the productivity gains created during the AI transition and achieve a just transition so that disadvantages do not disproportionately affect vulnerable groups. Besides the two keynote speakers, senior research fellow Jang Ji-yeon of the Korea Labor Institute will participate as a panelist. ( 두 번째 기조 강연은 ‘에이아이(AI) 전환과 깊어지는 불평등, 누가 감당하며 어떻게 나눠야 하나?’를 주제로 세라 오코너 영국 파이낸셜타임스 부편집인이 맡는다. 인공지능 번역 결과물을 수정하는 작업으로 전락한 번역가들, 로봇에 둘러싸인 물류창고 노동자들, 소프트웨어로 면접을 보는 대졸 취업 지원자 등 기술 변화의 최전선을 직접 취재한 경험을 토대로 ‘일자리 질’의 변화를 깊숙이 파헤친다. 그가 던지는 질문은 다음과 같은 것들이다. 기계가 이들의 일자리를 뺏는 것이 아니라, 노동자가 기계의 시스템 안에 끼워지고 있는 것은 아닌가, 그로 인해 공정함, 능력, 인간다움과 같은 근본적 질문도 그 시스템(알고리즘) 안에서 재정의되고 있는 건 아닐까? 오코너 부편집인은 19세기 영국 면방직 공장 노동자부터 21세기 스웨덴 광산 노동자까지, 기계에 맞서 더 인간적인 노동 조건을 쟁취하려 했던 이들의 저항의 역사에서 알고리즘에 맞설 대안을 찾는다. )

There will also be a session discussing various changes happening in the field. Park Young-sun, Chair of the Strategic Economic Advisory Council (and former Minister of SMEs and Startups), will moderate a vivid discussion on the theme 'The Transition Scene: Workplaces, How Can We Work with AI?' Experts at the forefront of change, including Eum Sung-won, Head of Communications at OpenAI Korea; Hong Sung-joon, Design Director at Bank Salad; Lee Deok-man, Center Director at POSCO Holdings AI & Robotics Convergence Research Institute; and Yoo Jae-yeon, Head of the Social Committee of the National AI Strategy, will share their on-the-ground experiences of 'how to work with AI.' ( 기조연설을 잇는 라운드테이블에서는 이상헌 국제노동기구(ILO) 수석 이코노미스트가 좌장을 맡아 ‘새로 쓰는 에이아이(AI) 전환의 규칙:제도와 연대의 설계’를 주제로 열띤 토론이 펼쳐진다. 인공지능 전환 과정에서 창출된 생산성 이익을 어떻게 분배할 것인가, 취약계층에게 불이익이 집중되지 않도록 정의로운 전환을 이룰 것인가 등을 놓고 각 나라의 경험을 공유하며 대안을 모색한다. 두 명의 기조연사 외 장지연 한국노동연구원 선임연구위원이 패널로 참석한다.)

Right after lunch, novelist Jang Kang-myung, author of *The Future That Has Already Arrived*, will give a special lecture. He will examine the changes that have hit the world of Go since the AlphaGo shock and share insightful questions about the 'future of work.' ( 현장에서 일어나는 다양한 변화를 논의하는 세션도 마련됐다. 박영선 전략경제자문단 위원장(전 중소벤처기업부 장관)이 좌장을 맡아 ‘전환의 현장·일터, 어떻게 에이아이(AI)와 함께 일할 수 있을까?’를 주제로 생생한 논의가 펼쳐질 예정이다. 음성원 오픈에이아이(AI) 코리아 커뮤니케이션 총괄, 홍성준 뱅크샐러드 디자인 총괄 이사, 이덕만 포스코홀딩스 에이아이(AI)로봇융합연구소 센터장, 유재연 국가인공지능전략위 사회분과장 등 변화의 최전선에 있는 전문가들이 각자의 현장에서 경험한 ‘인공지능과 함께 일하는 방법'을 공유한다. )

Han Gwi-young, Director of the People and Digital Research Institute hgy4215@hani.co.kr ( 점심 직후에는 ‘먼저 온 미래’의 저자인 장강명 작가가 특별강연에 나선다. 알파고 쇼크 이후 바둑계에 닥친 변화를 짚으면서 ‘일의 미래’에 대한 통찰력 있는 질문을 나눌 예정이다.)

item.title: "Corporate Supercars with Light Green License Plates Become a Trend as 'Flex'… Tax Audit if Embezzlement Is Confirmed" (“연두색 번호판 단 법인 슈퍼카, ‘플렉스’라며 유행…유용 확인시 세무조사”)
item.description:
National Tax Service Commissioner Lim Kwang-hyun warned that if there is evidence of private use of corporate-owned supercars, a strict tax audit will be conducted. (임광현 국세청장이 법인 명의 슈퍼카의 사적 유용 혐의가 확인될 경우 엄정하게 세무조사를 하겠다고 경고했다.)

In a post on X (formerly Twitter) on the 25th, Commissioner Lim stated, "The National Tax Service is thoroughly analyzing and verifying the acquisition, operation, and expense processing details of high-priced corporate vehicles," adding, "If suspicions of private use by the owner's family are confirmed, we will conduct a rigorous tax audit." (임 청장은 25일 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 글을 올려 “국세청은 고가 법인 차량의 취득·운행·비용 처리 내역 등을 철저히 분석 검증 중”이라며 “사주 일가의 사적 유용 혐의가 확인되는 경우 엄정하게 세무조사를 실시하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Commissioner Lim pointed out, "Some wealthy individuals purchase supercars worth hundreds of millions of won under the company's name, use them for personal purposes such as family outings, golf, or visits to entertainment venues, and then process the expenses as corporate costs, thereby evading taxes." He added, "Driving a supercar should be done with personal funds; buying it with company money and processing it as an expense is akin to having the state, i.e., your taxes, bear part of that cost." (임 청장은 “일부 자산가는 수억원대 슈퍼카를 회사 명의로 구입한 뒤 가족 외출, 골프, 유흥업소 방문 등 사적으로 사용하면서 이를 회사 비용으로 처리해 세금을 탈루해 왔다”고 지적했다. 그는 “슈퍼카를 개인 돈으로 굴려야지, 회사 돈으로 사서 비용 처리하는 것은 그 비용의 일부를 국가가 부담하는, 즉 여러분의 세금으로 부담해 주는 것과 같다”고 덧붙였다.)

The National Tax Service conducted a large-scale tax audit on such tax evasion practices in 2020. Subsequently, a system requiring light green license plates for corporate vehicles worth over 80 million won was introduced, temporarily reducing the registration of high-priced corporate cars. However, the numbers have recently increased again. According to the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, new registrations of corporate vehicles worth over 100 million won decreased from 51,542 in 2023 to 33,960 in 2024, but rebounded to 39,429 last year. Commissioner Lim explained, "Recently, the light green license plate has been perceived as a symbol of status for wealthy business owners, leading to an increase in the purchase of high-priced corporate vehicles again." (국세청은 이 같은 탈루 행태에 대해 2020년 대대적인 세무조사를 벌였다. 이후 8천만원 이상 법인 차량에 연두색 번호판을 사용하는 제도가 도입됐고, 고가 법인 차량 등록 대수도 일시적으로 감소했지만 최근 다시 늘어나는 추세다. 국토교통부에 따르면 1억원 이상 법인 명의 신규등록 차량은 2023년 5만1542대에서 2024년 3만3960대로 줄었으나 지난해에는 3만9429대로 늘었다. 임 청장은 “최근에 오히려 연두색 번호판이 기업체를 보유한 자산가의 상징처럼 인식되면서 법인 명의의 고가 차량 구매가 다시 증가하는 양상”이라고 설명했다.)

Commissioner Lim emphasized, "Purchasing a supercar under the corporate name, using it privately, and processing it as a corporate expense is not merely an ethical issue but a clear act of tax evasion. This must be eradicated not only for tax justice but also to normalize abnormal practices." (임 청장은 “슈퍼카를 법인 명의로 구입해 사적으로 사용하면서 법인 비용으로 처리하는 행위는 단순한 도덕적 문제가 아닌 명백한 탈세 행위”라며 “조세정의 실현뿐 아니라 비정상의 정상화 차원에서도 반드시 근절돼야 한다”고 강조했다.)

Earlier, President Lee Jae-myung asked at a cabinet meeting on the 20th, "Are there still cases of buying luxury foreign cars for the chairman's son or grandson to drive around privately?" Commissioner Lim responded, "Driving supercars with different-colored plates has become a trend, seen as a 'flex.' We will launch an investigation soon." (앞서 이재명 대통령은 지난 20일 국무회의에서 “고급 외제차를 사서 회장 아들이나 손자가 개인적으로 끌고 다니는 사례가 요즘은 없나”라고 물었고, 임 청장은 “(번호판) 색깔을 달리한 슈퍼카를 타는 게 오히려 플렉스라며 유행을 하고 있다. 조만간 (조사에) 착수하겠다”고 밝힌 바 있다.)

Reporter Kim Yoon-ju kyj@hani.co.kr (김윤주 기자 kyj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Apply Online Now for the Abandoned House Demolition Support Program (빈집 철거 지원사업, 이제 온라인으로 신청하세요)
item.description:
The 'Abandoned House Demolition Support Program', which provides financial support for the demolition of privately owned abandoned houses, will now be available for online application. (개인 소유의 빈집 철거 비용을 지원해주는 ‘빈집철거지원사업’을 앞으로는 온라인으로 신청할 수 있다.)

The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs announced on the 25th that they will introduce an online application system for the abandoned house demolition support program. This program supports demolition costs from cities, counties, or districts under the condition that the site of a privately owned abandoned house is used for public purposes, such as a parking lot, vegetable garden, or rest area, for a certain period after demolition. <<> Until now, the abandoned house demolition support program was conducted only through offline methods, requiring owners to visit the city, county, or district office where the abandoned house was located to apply. Not only did this cause inconvenience for owners residing in other areas, but it also placed a heavy administrative burden on local government officials, who had to individually track down owners to confirm their intention to demolish and provide guidance. <<> Owners of abandoned houses wishing for demolition can now easily apply online for the abandoned house demolition support program through the 'Binzipae' website (www.binzibe.kr). Once an application is submitted, the relevant local government official reviews the condition of the abandoned house and related documents, such as the property register, to determine eligibility for final support. <<> Kim Hyeong-cheol, head of the Urban Vitality Support Division at the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and Seo Jeong-ho, head of the Rural Regeneration Support Team at the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, stated, "This system, created through collaboration between the two ministries, is expected to accelerate the pace of abandoned house maintenance," and added, "We will continue to work together to effectively resolve the issue of abandoned houses." <<> Reporter Lee Ji-hye: godot@hani.co.kr (국토교통부와 농림축산식품부는 빈집철거지원사업의 온라인 신청 시스템을 도입한다고 25일 밝혔다. 이 사업은 개인 소유의 빈집을 철거한 뒤 해당 부지를 일정 기간 주차장이나 텃밭, 쉼터 등으로 공공 활용하는 조건으로 시·군·구에서 철거 비용을 지원해주는 사업이다.)

item.title: In the Three Months Since Multi-Homeowners Released Properties, 11,000 Seoul Citizens Bought Homes in Gyeonggi Province (다주택자 매물 풀린 3개월간 서울시민 1만1천명, 경기도에 집 샀다)
item.description:
Ahead of the end of the penalty exemption on capital gains tax for multi-homeowners in adjusted areas, including Seoul, over 10,000 Seoul citizens purchased homes in Gyeonggi Province over three months. <<> According to the court registry information portal on the 25th, among buyers of collective buildings in Gyeonggi Province from February to April, 11,614 were Seoul residents, an increase of 832 from the previous three months (17,082). Monthly figures showed 3,815 in February, 3,951 in March, and 3,848 in April. This is interpreted as a result of multi-homeowners, seeking to avoid the heavy capital gains tax, first putting up properties they owned in Seoul’s outskirts or Gyeonggi Province for sale, leading to a concentration of purchasing demand in Gyeonggi areas with favorable living conditions. <<> Notably, areas with good access to Seoul and advantageous in terms of living environment and price ranges saw an increase in buyers compared to the previous three months. Buying activity was brisk in regions adjacent to Seoul: Goyang (619 → 739 people) near northwestern Seoul, Gwangmyeong (48 → 698 people) bordering southwestern Seoul, as well as Guri (399 → 605 people) and Namyangju (667 → 877 people) near northeastern Seoul. Other areas like Anyang Dongan-gu (509 → 537 people), Yongin Suji-gu (398 → 468 people), Yongin Giheung-gu (232 → 320 people), and Hwaseong Dongtan-gu (190 → 289 people) also saw increased purchasing demand from Seoul residents. <<> The advantage of these areas is their high cost-effectiveness, with a wealth of new constructions compared to Seoul’s outskirts, which have many older apartments, and lower price points. For example, a 112-square-yard unit (3rd floor) of DMC Hangang Xi the Heritage in Deokeun District, Deokyang-gu, Goyang (completed at the end of 2022) was sold for 1.13 billion won on the 29th of last month, which is significantly lower than similar-sized units in major Seoul areas. <<> The steep rise in Seoul jeonse prices is also cited as another factor driving moves to neighboring Gyeonggi Province. In Seoul’s Jungnang-gu, a 112-square-yard jeonse recently recorded on the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport’s real transaction price system ranges from 400 to 500 million won, while in neighboring Guri, a 79-square-yard unit was traded for 546 million won on the 30th of last month. This suggests that by moving areas and downsizing, one could consider transitioning from renting to homeownership under favorable conditions. <<> Nam Hyuk-woo, a researcher at Woori Bank’s Real Estate Research Institute, said, “If people who have been living on jeonse in Seoul’s outskirts find it difficult to continue at that jeonse price, they can add a little more money to the deposit and move to a slightly smaller new construction in Gyeonggi Province,” adding, “It’s a shift where tenants buy apartments with better product value in adjacent areas.” <<> Reporter Lee Ji-hye godot@hani.co.kr (서울 등 조정대상지역의 다주택자 양도소득세 중과 유예 종료를 앞두고 3개월 동안 1만명이 넘는 서울시민이 경기 지역 주택을 매수한 것으로 나타났다.)

item.title: ‘Starbucks Boycott’ Spreads… Partner Card Companies on Edge over Potential Risks (‘스벅 불매운동’ 확산…제휴 맺은 카드사들, 리스크 떠안을까 긴장)
item.description:
As the Starbucks boycott fueled by ‘Tank Day’ marketing gains traction, card companies that have partnered with Starbucks, touting perks like ‘free drink star rewards,’ are growing tense. (‘탱크데이(Tank Day)’ 마케팅으로 스타벅스 불매운동이 확산하면서, ‘스벅 무료음료 별적립 혜택’ 등을 앞세워 스타벅스와 제휴를 맺은 카드사들이 긴장하고 있다.)

According to the card industry on the 25th, Woori Card, which launched the ‘Startravel Woori Card’ in early April, and Samsung Card, which introduced the ‘Starbucks Samsung Card’ in late September last year, are closely monitoring the situation. Reports indicate that a noticeable wave of customer card cancellations has yet to emerge. In the case of Shinhan Card, it had previously signed a business agreement with Starbucks Korea on the 7th to officially launch a co-branded private label credit card (PLCC) in the first half of this year, but it announced it would reconsider the launch timing, factoring in internal system checks and the fallout from this incident. (25일 카드업계에 따르면 지난 4월 초 ‘스타트래블 우리카드’를 출시한 우리카드와 지난해 9월 말부터 ‘스타벅스 삼성카드’를 출시한 삼성카드는 이번 사태를 예의 주시하고 있다. 고객들의 카드 해지 움직임이 아직은 뚜렷이 나타나고 있는 건 아닌 것으로 전해진다. 신한카드의 경우 앞서 지난 7일 스타벅스 제휴 상업자표시신용카드(PLCC)를 올 상반기에 정식 출시하기로 스타벅스코리아와 업무협약을 체결했는데, 내부 시스템 점검과 이번 사태 여파 등을 고려해 출시 시점을 재검토한다고 밝혔다.)

Initially, Starbucks had maintained an exclusive partnership with Hyundai Card for the past six years, but shifted its strategy in the second half of last year by forging alliances with multiple other card companies, including Samsung Card. Card companies that broke Hyundai Card’s monopoly and secured Starbucks partnerships are now baffled by the eruption of the boycott crisis early in the venture. (당초 스타벅스는 최근 6년간 현대카드와 단독 파트너십을 이어오다가 지난해 하반기에 전략을 바꿔 삼성카드 등 다른 복수의 카드사들과 제휴를 맺었다. 카드사들은 현대카드 독점을 깨고 스타벅스 제휴가 성사됐는데, 사업 초기에 스타벅스 불매운동 확산 사태가 터지자 당혹스러워하고 있다.)

Unlike general co-branded cards that mix benefits from multiple merchants to diversify risk, the PLCC business structurally ties the two companies into a de facto ‘fate community,’ meaning that if controversy arises for the partner, risks can directly spill over to the card company. This is because PLCCs involve the card company and partner sharing costs and revenues, focusing on benefits tied to the brand. Samsung Card, Woori Card, and Shinhan Card all emphasize reward benefits like ‘Starbucks star accumulation’ for free drinks. According to Starbucks Korea’s audit report, the so-called ‘deferred revenue’ (contract liability) items, such as star accruals to be redeemed for beverages for customers, saw a new total of 168.5 billion won generated last year, and after deducting the amount used (156 billion won), the balance at year-end stood at 26.7 billion won (including a 14.2 billion won balance at year-end 2024). (여러 가맹점의 혜택을 섞어 제공해 리스크가 분산되는 일반 제휴카드와 달리, 상업자표시신용카드 사업은 두 회사가 사실상 ‘운명 공동체’로 묶이는 구조적 특성을 띠고 있어 제휴사에 논란이 생기면 리스크가 카드사로 직접 번질 수 있다. 피엘시시(PLCC)는 카드사와 제휴사가 비용과 수익을 공동으로 부담하고 해당 브랜드의 혜택에 집중해 상품을 만들기 때문이다. 삼성·우리·신한카드 모두 ‘스타벅스 별 적립’ 등 무료 음료제공 리워드 혜택에 집중하고 있다. 스타벅스 코리아 감사보고서를 보면, 고객에게 음료로 지급해야 할 별 적립액 등 이른바 ‘이연수익’(계약부채) 항목의 경우 작년에 총 1685억원어치가 새로 발생했으며 사용된 금액(1560억원어치)을 제외하면 작년말 잔액은 267억원(2024년말 잔액 142억원 포함)에 이른다.)

A card company official said, “PLCCs have the significant effect of attracting loyal customers of the partner brand, but they also have a structural weakness—marketing costs are high, and if a boycott or similar issue arises, the impact is fully shared between the partners.” (카드사 관계자는 “피엘시시는 제휴 브랜드의 충성 고객을 유입시키는 효과가 큰 만큼, 마케팅 비용도 크고 불매 운동 등이 일어나면 타격을 고스란히 나눠 가지게 되는 구조적 약점이 있다”고 말했다.)

Senior Reporter Jo Gyewan kyewan@hani.co.kr (조계완 선임기자 kyewan@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Leverage Allowed for ‘Samsung-Hynix’ ETFs, but Marketing ‘Restraint’ Ordered… Asset Managers Complain (‘삼전닉스’ 레버리지 허용했는데 홍보 ‘자제령’…운용사들 불만)
item.description:
Ahead of the launch of single-stock leveraged products for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix on the 27th, the Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) has begun cracking down on marketing that encourages excessive investment. The financial authorities, which had approved the introduction of these products to redirect funds from the so-called ‘Seohak ant’ investors, cited as one cause of the high exchange rate, back into the domestic market, now appear anxious as recent stock market volatility has expanded. <<> An FSS official said on the 25th, “We have advised the industry to refrain from excessive marketing as single-stock leveraged products carry significant investment risks.” Accordingly, some asset management companies set to launch on the 27th have partially cancelled planned marketing events, such as press conferences, investor briefings, and product giveaway events. The FSS has instructed that even if press conferences are held, they should avoid acts that encourage investment or induce buying, and focus on product explanations and disclosure of investment risks. <<> In the industry, there is grumbling, with some saying it is difficult to understand why a new product can be launched but not actively promoted — “If this is the case, why was the product launch approved?” There are also complaints from smaller and mid-sized firms that, given the nature of single-stock products, there is little differentiation between asset managers, and if events are restricted, it inevitably benefits large asset managers with brand recognition and sales networks. <<> Initially, single-stock leveraged products were introduced with the aim of redirecting individual investment funds flowing into overseas stock markets back to the domestic market. The goal was to resolve the ‘asymmetric regulation’ where such products based on domestic blue-chip stocks are listed in the US and Hong Kong markets but banned in Korea. <<> However, as the stock market overheats, the financial authorities’ stance has changed. When Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won formally announced the product launch on January 28, the KOSPI closed at 5,170.81, but it has now fluctuated sharply and is on the verge of breaking the 8,000-point mark. With Samsung Electronics and Hynix’s market capitalization nearing half of the entire KOSPI, there are concerns that single-stock leveraged products could further stimulate this trend. <<> Market observers expect that the initial capital inflow at launch will not be insignificant. From April 28 to May 21, when mandatory in-depth education for trading these products began, a total of 93,000 people completed the course. Including professional investors and foreigners who are exempt from the in-depth education, actual investment demand is expected to be even higher. <<> Single-stock leveraged products track the daily percentage change in the underlying asset at a 2x multiplier. On the 27th, a total of 16 products will be listed simultaneously, including 14 leveraged products and 2 inverse 2x products. Considering the daily price limit of 30% in the domestic stock market, investors could face a maximum loss of 60%. <<> In a sideways market, the ‘negative compounding effect’ can erode investment capital, making these products unsuitable for long-term investment. For example, if the index falls by 20% and then rises by 20%, a regular product goes from 100 to 80 to 96, resulting in a 4% loss, but a leveraged product falls by 40% and then rises by 40%, going from 100 to 60 to 84, incurring a 16% loss. <<> Reporter Ahn Tae-ho eco@hani.co.kr (오는 27일 삼성전자·에스케이(SK)하이닉스 단일종목 레버리지 상품 출시를 앞두고 금융감독원이 과도한 투자를 부추기는 마케팅 단속에 나섰다. 고환율의 원인 중 하나로 지목된 ‘서학개미’ 자금을 국내 시장으로 돌리겠다며 상품 도입을 허용했던 금융당국이 최근 증시 변동성이 확대되자 되레 노심초사하는 모양새다.)

item.title: Starbucks Gift Vouchers Overtaken by Mega Coffee, Plunge in KakaoTalk Gift Rankings... Impact of Boycott Movement (메가커피에 밀린 스벅 교환권, 카톡 선물하기 순위 급락…불매운동 영향)
item.description:
Starbucks gift vouchers, once a popular choice on KakaoTalk's gift-giving service, have seen their rankings drop following the controversy over the disparagement of the 'May 18 Democratic Uprising.' This is believed to be the effect of a boycott movement triggered by the 'Tank Day' promotion. (카카오톡 선물하기에서 인기 선물로 꼽히던 스타벅스 교환권이 ‘5·18 민주화 운동’ 폄훼 논란 이후 순위가 하락한 것으로 나타났다. ‘탱크데이’ 프로모션에 따른 불매운동의 영향으로 풀이된다.)

According to the 'All' popularity rankings within the 'Gift Voucher' category on KakaoTalk's gift-giving service on the 25th, Starbucks gift vouchers, which had consistently ranked first or second, fell to 7th place as of 10 a.m. that day. The top two spots were taken by Baedal Minjok gift certificates. However, Shinsegae gift certificates maintained their high ranking at third place. (25일 카카오톡 선물하기 내의 ‘교환권’ 카테고리 내 ‘전체’ 인기 순위를 보면, 그동안 1∼2위를 차지하던 스타벅스 교환권은 이날 오전 10시 기준 7위로 밀려났다. 1∼2위 자리는 배달의민족 상품권이 차지했다. 다만 신세계상품권은 3위를 차지해 상위권을 유지했다.)

Starbucks gift vouchers also lost their top spot in the 'Cafe' popularity rankings, which they had held until the previous day, to Mega Coffee. Mega Coffee product vouchers took first, second, and fourth places, while Starbucks product vouchers dropped to third. (스타벅스 교환권은 전날까지 1∼2위를 차지하던 ‘카페’ 인기 순위에서도 이날 메가커피에 자리를 내줬다. 1∼2위, 4위는 메가커피 상품 교환권이 차지했고 스타벅스 상품 교환권은 3위를 기록했다.)

Following the 'Tank Day' controversy, ministries, local governments, and public institutions have stopped purchasing Starbucks vouchers used as prizes, and private companies are also replacing Starbucks vouchers used as giveaways with vouchers from other brands. (이번 ‘탱크데이’ 논란 이후 부처·지방정부·공공기관 등은 경품으로 사용해온 스타벅스 상품권 구매를 중단했고, 민간기업들도 경품으로 사용하던 스타벅스 상품권을 다른 브랜드 상품권으로 교체하는 분위기다.)

The boycott movement among citizens continues. A person surnamed Kim (34) said, "I gave a Starbucks gift voucher to an acquaintance two days before the controversy erupted, but as the boycott spread, I felt sorry because it might be awkward for them to use it. Since there are many alternatives, I have no plans to give Starbucks vouchers as gifts in the future." (시민들의 불매 움직임도 이어지고 있다. 김아무개(34)씨는 “논란이 터지기 이틀 전 지인에게 스타벅스 교환권을 선물했는데, 불매운동이 확산하면서 지인이 사용하기 곤란해할 것 같아 오히려 미안한 마음이 들었다”며 “대체재가 많으니 앞으로는 스타벅스 교환권을 선물할 계획이 없다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, as the controversy over Starbucks' disparagement of the 'May 18 Democratic Uprising' shows no signs of subsiding, Jeong Yong-jin, Chairman of Shinsegae Group, is scheduled to issue a public apology on the 26th. (한편, 스타벅스의 ‘5·18 민주화 운동’ 폄훼 논란이 가라앉지 않자, 정용진 신세계그룹 회장은 오는 26일 대국민 사과에 나설 예정이다.)

Reporter Lee Ju-bin yes@hani.co.kr (이주빈 기자 yes@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 30-year U.S. Treasury yield hits 5.2% for first time in 9 years (30년 미국채 금리 5.2% 터치…9년 만에 처음)
item.description:
With Kevin Warsh officially taking office as the new Chair of the Federal Reserve, there are even forecasts that the U.S. policy rate could rise by 50bp within this year. (케빈 워시 새 연방준비제도(Fed·연준) 의장이 정식 취임한 가운데 미국 정책금리가 올해 연내 50bp 인상될 거라는 전망까지 나오고 있다.)

On the 23rd (local time), the yield on the 30-year long-term U.S. Treasury bond, an ultra-long-term instrument, stood at 5.082% annually. Earlier on the 19th, it briefly surged to 5.20%, up 7bp (1bp = 0.01 percentage point) from the previous day. This marks the first time the 30-year yield has reached 5.20% since July 2007, just before the global financial crisis. (지난 23일(현지시각) 미 국채 초장기물인 30년 만기 금리는 연 5.082%를 기록했다. 앞서 지난 19일에는 한때 전일 대비 7bp(1bp=0.01%포인트) 오른 5.20%까지 치솟았다. 30년물 금리가 5.20%에 도달한 것은 글로벌 금융위기 직전인 2007년 7월 이후 처음이다.)

The main reason behind the sharp rise in long-term U.S. bond yields is the growing expectation that the Fed will implement a rate hike within this year, driven by concerns over inflation reigniting due to high oil prices stemming from the U.S.-Israel-Iran conflict. According to the CME FedWatch Tool on the 25th, the interest rate futures market priced in a 41.1% probability that the Fed will raise the current rate (3.50-3.75%) by 25bp by December. One month ago, this probability was zero. (미 장기채 금리가 급등하는 주요 배경은 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁발 고유가에 따른 인플레이션 재점화 우려에 연준이 연내 금리 인상을 단행할 거라는 전망이 확산하고 있기 때문이다. 25일 시카고상품거래소(CME) 페드워치에 따르면, 금리선물 시장에서는 연준이 오는 12월까지 금리(현행 3.50~3.75%)를 25bp 인상할 확률을 41.1%로 반영했다. 한 달 전에 이 확률은 ‘제로’였다.)

In contrast, the probability of a rate freeze dropped from 75.9% a month ago to 32.9%. The likelihood of a rate cut has completely disappeared, and even the probability of a 50bp increase (to 4.00-4.25%) has notably risen to 18.9%. The Fed had ended its monetary tightening stance in September 2024 after four and a half years by cutting the policy rate by 0.5 percentage points from 5.25-5.50%, but expectations of further rate cuts have now vanished, with a growing consensus shifting toward a freeze or even a rate hike. (반면 금리동결 확률은 1개월 전 75.9%에서 32.9%로 낮아졌다. 금리 인하 확률은 아예 사라졌고, 50bp 인상(4.00~4.25%) 확률조차 18.9%까지 확연히 많아졌다. 연준은 2024년 9월 정책금리를 5.25∼5.50%에서 0.5%포인트 내리며 4년 반 만에 통화긴축 기조를 끝냈으나, 이제 금리 추가 인하 기대는 사라지고 동결을 넘어 인상에 나설 거라는 전망이 확산하고 있다.)

On the 22nd, Kevin Warsh, newly inaugurated as Fed Chair, faces widespread expectations that it will not be easy to deliver the rate cuts desired by President Donald Trump. In his inaugural speech, Warsh stated, "The Fed's duty is to promote price stability and maximum employment. By pursuing this with an independent and resolute stance, inflation will decrease, economic growth will strengthen, and real disposable income will rise." According to the International Financial Center, Trump remarked that day, "I hope Chair Warsh performs his duties excellently, completely independently, without regard to anyone, including Trump himself." However, he later said at another event in New York, "If interest rates come down, everyone will be happy." (지난 22일 연준 의장에 새로 취임한 케빈 워시가 도널드 트럼프 대통령이 원하는 금리 인하를 끌어내기는 쉽지 않다는 전망이 지배적이다. 워시 의장은 취임 연설에서 “연준의 책무는 물가 안정과 최대 고용 촉진이며, 독립적이고 단호한 자세로 이를 추구할 때 인플레이션은 낮아지고 경제성장은 강해지며 실질가처분 소득은 높아질 것”이라고 말했다. 국제금융센터에 따르면, 이날 트럼프 대통령은 “워시 의장이 트럼프 자신을 포함한 누구도 보지 말고 완전히 독립적으로 직무를 훌륭하게 해내길 희망한다”고 언급하면서도 이후 뉴욕의 다른 행사에서 “금리가 낮아진다면 모두가 행복할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Even Christopher Waller, a Fed governor typically classified as dovish (preferring monetary easing), recently stated in a lecture at a Frankfurt conference, "If inflation does not moderate soon, we can no longer rule out the possibility of future rate hikes." He also added, "Inflation is not moving in the desired direction, and I support removing the phrase 'easing bias' from future Fed monetary policy statements." (비둘기파 성향(통화완화 선호)으로 분류돼온 크리스토퍼 월러 연준 이사마저 최근 프랑크푸르트 컨퍼런스 강연에서 “인플레이션이 조만간 진정되지 않는다면 향후 금리 인상 가능성을 더는 배제할 수 없다”고 말했다. 그는 또 “인플레이션이 바람직한 방향으로 가고 있지 않으며, 향후 연준 통화정책결정 성명서에서 ‘완화적 금리 편향’(easing bias) 표현을 삭제하는 걸 지지한다”고 발언했다.)

In particular, there are observations that the Fed has recently become very cautious in evaluating oil-driven inflation as 'transitory.' After misjudging the global inflation of 2021-2022—immediately following COVID-19—as a "temporary phenomenon," the Fed faced criticism for missing the appropriate timing for rate hikes and then belatedly resorting to steep increases like 'big steps' or 'giant steps.' Chair Warsh was also one of those who criticized this as "the biggest failure and error in 50 years of Fed monetary policy." (특히 최근 연준이 고유가발 인플레이션을 ‘일시적’이라고 평가하는 데 매우 신중해졌다는 관측도 있다. 연준은 코로나19 직후 2021~2022년 글로벌 인플레이션을 “일시적 현상”으로 오판했다가 적절한 금리 인상 시기를 놓치고, 뒤늦게 ‘빅스텝·자이언트스텝’ 같은 가파른 인상에 나섰다는 비판에 직면한 바 있다. 워시 의장도 이를 “50년 간의 연준 통화정책 중 가장 큰 실패이자 오류”라고 비판한 인물 중 한명이다.)

On the 28th, the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis will release the April index of Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE), the Fed's preferred inflation indicator for the U.S. economy. The market expects this index to have further risen to around 3.9% in April, following a sharp jump from 2.8% (year-over-year) in February to 3.5% in March. (오는 28일 미국 경제분석국은, 연준이 선호하는 미국경제 인플레 지표인 개인소비지출(PCE) 4월 지수를 발표한다. 이 지수는 지난 2월 2.8%(전년동기대비)에서 3월에 3.5%로 급등한데 이어 4월에도 3.9% 안팎으로 추가 상승했을 것으로 시장은 예상한다.)

Senior Reporter Jo Kyewan kyewan@hani.co.kr (조계완 선임기자 kyewan@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Coin Taxation Stalled by 'Financial Investment Tax Abolition'… "Must Be Discussed Together for Fairness" (‘금투세 폐지’에 발목 잡힌 코인 과세…“형평성 차원서 함께 논의해야”)
item.description:
Ahead of the implementation of the virtual asset taxation law in January next year, investors and political circles are expressing backlash. They point to the abolished financial investment income tax (FIIT) on stock investment income, arguing that the taxation lacks fairness. Voices are emerging that, to ensure the stable implementation of virtual asset taxation, the reintroduction of FIIT should also be discussed in line with the principle of 'taxing where there is income.' <<> According to the National Assembly's public petition board on the 25th, a petition titled 'Petition for the Abolition of Virtual Asset Taxation' filed on the 13th by a person surnamed Min has garnered over 54,000 signatures and is set to be referred to the National Assembly's Strategy and Finance Committee. Public petitions that receive more than 50,000 signatures within 30 days of publication are referred to the relevant standing committee for review. Min wrote, "A full-scale re-discussion, including abolition rather than forced taxation, is necessary." <<> Virtual asset taxation was officially established at the government level in 2020 and has since been postponed three times. At the time, the Moon Jae-in administration proposed a tax reform bill imposing a 22% tax rate on annual profits exceeding 2.5 million won from virtual assets, citing fairness with other income types like labor and business, as well as international cases. By the end of that year, the National Assembly passed an amendment to the Income Tax Act to tax virtual asset profits starting January 2022, but ahead of the presidential election in 2021, the ruling and opposition parties postponed the implementation to 2023. In 2022, the Yoon Suk Yeol government delayed it further to 2025, citing the need to establish investor protection measures, and in late 2024, the parties, swayed by investor sentiment, postponed it again to 2027. <<> The issue intensified when, around that time, the ruling and opposition parties also agreed to abolish the FIIT, which imposed a maximum 27.5% tax rate on profits from stocks and funds, fueling controversy over fairness with virtual asset taxation. With the abolition of FIIT, the current stock capital gains tax in South Korea applies a maximum 27.5% rate only to shareholders with holdings of 5 billion won or more per stock, and most individual investors pay no tax on capital gains. This has led to arguments that reducing the tax burden on stock investment income while imposing a 22% tax solely on coins is unbalanced. In March, the People Power Party also proposed a bill to abolish virtual asset taxation, stating that "imposing a separate income tax on virtual assets while FIIT is abolished undermines the consistency of the tax system." Meanwhile, the Democratic Party said, "Full-scale discussion will be possible only after the June 3 local elections." <<> The government maintains its stance to implement virtual asset taxation as planned from next year, but by excluding the reintroduction of FIIT from the discussion, it is fueling the fairness controversy. The Ministry of Economy and Finance stated, "Since there have been no changes so far, our basic position is to impose taxation from January next year," but regarding the introduction of FIIT, it said, "There is nothing under review at the moment." In response, Moon Seong, president of the Korean Association of Tax and Policy Studies and a professor at Hanyang Women's University's Department of Tax and Accounting, pointed out, "Virtual asset taxation and FIIT must be discussed together for fairness. If we only discuss virtual asset taxation while leaving FIIT aside, tax resistance will inevitably be severe. However, the government's discussion on reintroducing FIIT has gone missing, likely due to concerns that it could dampen the stock market." <<> There are also concerns that virtual asset taxation could be postponed again due to market conditions. One tax expert told The Hankyoreh, "Since the current virtual asset market is not in good shape, imposing taxation would inevitably provoke strong investor backlash. There is a considerable possibility that the government and National Assembly, wary of public opinion, may delay it again." <<> Reporter Shin Min-jung shin@hani.co.kr (내년 1월 가상자산 과세법 시행을 앞두고 투자자·정치권의 반발이 이어지고 있다. 주식투자 소득 등에 대해 매기는 금투세(금융투자소득세)가 폐지된 상황을 거론하며 ‘형평성에 어긋난다’고 주장하는 것이다. 가상자산 과세 안착을 위해서는 ‘소득 있는 곳에 세금 있다’는 원칙에 따라 금투세 도입도 함께 논의해야 한다는 목소리가 나온다. )

item.title: Chung Yong-jin to Issue Public Apology Over Starbucks' May 18 Distortion Incident Tomorrow—What Will It Contain? (정용진, 내일 ‘5·18 폄훼’ 스벅 사태 대국민 사과…어떤 내용 담길까)
item.description:
Amid ongoing controversy over Starbucks' perceived belittling of the May 18 Democratic Uprising, attention is focused on what content will be included in Shinsegae Group Chairman Chung Yong-jin's public apology scheduled for the 26th. (스타벅스의 ‘5·18 민주화운동’ 폄훼 논란이 가라앉지 않고 있는 가운데, 26일 있을 정용진 신세계그룹 회장의 대국민 사과에 어떤 내용이 담길지에 관심이 쏠리고 있다.)

According to a summary of retail industry explanations on the 25th, Shinsegae Group is known to have conducted a high-intensity audit of at least five relevant individuals, including the Starbucks Commerce Team, which was responsible for the controversial "May 18 Tank Day" marketing, to uncover the truth behind this incident. The group's audit organization is closely examining whether specific ideologies or political intentions were involved in the background of how the promotional phrases were conceived. In response, employees of the Commerce Team reportedly testified that the phrase "Thump on the desk!"—which recalls the cover-up of the torture death of activist Park Jong-chul—was merely a coincidence during the preparation of the three-step promotional phrases "'Snap on my hand!' 'Thump on the desk!' 'Tuck into the bag!'" and that there was absolutely no specific intent. (25일 유통업계 설명을 종합하면, 신세계그룹은 이번 사태의 진상을 규명하기 위해 논란이 된 ‘5‧18 탱크데이’ 마케팅을 담당한 스타벅스 커머스팀 등 유관자 5명 이상에 대한 고강도 감사를 한 것으로 알려졌다. 그룹 감사 조직은 홍보 문구가 기획된 배경을 두고 특정 이념이나 정치적 의도가 개입했는지를 집중적으로 들여다보고 있다. 이에 대해 커머스팀 직원들은 박종철 열사 고문치사 은폐 사건을 떠올리게 하는 ‘책상에 탁!’ 문구를 두고, “‘내 손에 착!’ ‘책상에 탁!’ ‘가방에 쏙!’이라는 3단계 홍보 문구를 준비하는 과정에서 우연히 겹쳤을 뿐, 특정한 의도는 전혀 없었다”고 진술한 것으로 전해졌다.)

Previously, Starbucks faced harsh criticism for simultaneously exposing the phrases "Tank Day," "May 18," and "Thump on the desk!" during a tumbler marketing campaign on the anniversary of the May 18 Democratic Uprising. This was because these expressions were repeatedly pointed out to evoke not only the military crackdown with tanks by the new military regime during the May 18 Democratic Uprising but also the false announcement by the National Police Headquarters regarding the torture death of activist Park Jong-chul, which claimed that "thumping the desk made him groan and die." (앞서 스타벅스는 5·18 민주화운동 기념일에 텀블러 마케팅을 진행하며 ‘탱크데이’ ‘5/18’ ‘책상에 탁!’이라는 문구를 동시에 노출해 거센 비판을 받았다. 이 표현들이 5·18 민주화운동 당시 신군부의 탱크 진압은 물론, 박종철 열사 고문치사 사건 당시 치안본부의 “책상을 ‘탁’ 치니 ‘억’ 하고 죽었다”는 거짓 발표를 연상시킨다는 지적이 잇따랐기 때문이다.)

Since corporate audits typically follow procedures involving prior consent, interviews, and digital forensics of IT devices including work computers, it is estimated that verification of the relevant employees' work computers and mobile phones was also conducted in this investigation. (통상적으로 기업 감사에서는 대상자의 사전 동의와 면담을 거쳐 업무용 컴퓨터를 비롯한 아이티(IT) 기기 등을 디지털포렌식 하는 절차를 밟는만큼, 이번 조사에서도 관련 직원들의 업무용 컴퓨터와 휴대전화 검증이 이뤄졌을 것으로 추정된다.)

Accordingly, Chairman Chung's public apology, to be published on the 26th, is expected to go beyond a simple expression of regret and provide detailed accounts of the circumstances under which the inappropriate marketing phrases passed through without being filtered out internally and the reasons why the internal verification system failed to function. If intentionality or gross negligence on the part of internal employees is confirmed during the investigation, there is a possibility that measures for holding responsible parties accountable and organizational reforms will also be announced. (이에 따라 26일 발표될 정 회장의 대국민 사과에는 단순한 유감 표명을 넘어, 부적절한 마케팅 문구가 내부에서 걸러지지 않고 최종 승인된 경위와 내부 검수 체계가 작동하지 않은 원인이 상세히 담길 것으로 보인다. 만약 조사 과정에서 내부 직원의 고의성이나 중대한 과실이 확인됐다면, 이에 따른 관련자 문책과 조직 쇄신책도 함께 발표될 가능성이 있다.)

Reporter Lee Joo-bin yes@hani.co.kr (이주빈 기자 yes@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: “High Interest Rates, High Prices, High Exchange Rates Are the Cost of Success”… People Power Party: “Out-of-Body Rhetoric” (김용범 “고금리·고물가·고환율은 성공 비용”…국힘 “유체이탈 화법”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-beom, head of the Cheong Wa Dae policy office, stated that the recent high interest rates, high prices, and high exchange rates should be viewed as the “cost of success” rather than negatively. (김용범 청와대 정책실장이 최근의 고금리·고물가·고환율 상황을 ‘성공의 비용’이라며 부정적으로만 바라볼 필요는 없다고 말했다.)

In a Facebook post on the 24th, Director Kim said, “This year, the South Korean economy is entering a phase where the nominal growth rate, including price increases, is approaching 10%. The explosive corporate performance in the semiconductor and artificial intelligence (AI) sectors has improved terms of trade and raised export prices, creating a flow where corporate profits, wages, and asset prices rise together,” adding, “An upward adjustment of the overall price system in the economy is not a negative phenomenon in itself. Rather, it can be seen as a process in which the Korean economy, long accustomed to low growth and low prices, seeks a new equilibrium.” <<> He added, “Ultimately, today’s high interest rates, high prices, and high exchange rates are an unavoidable cost of success in the process of the Korean economy leaping to a new level,” and said, “It is not a precursor to a crisis but the friction noise of a leap forward.” <<> Regarding the high exchange rate situation, Director Kim said it is not due to a shortage of foreign currency, as during the foreign exchange crisis, but rather from foreign investors’ demand for currency exchange to realize profits from the sharp rise in domestic stock prices. He stated, “It is not a vulnerability of the Korean economy but a paradoxical phenomenon created by success. Now is the time to judge the situation based on the flow of foreign currency supply and demand and liquidity indicators, rather than the exchange rate level itself.” <<> On the rising interest rate trend, he said, “As the overall price system of the economy has risen, an environment has also formed where interest rates are less likely to stabilize quickly as in the past. What matters is not the interest rate level itself but the speed of the rise and volatility.” Regarding high prices, he stated, “Price increases stemming from supply shocks are difficult to control with monetary policy alone and are hard to resolve in the short term. An emergency response mobilizing all available policy tools is required, such as measures to stabilize energy prices, reform of unfair market structures like collusion, and voucher support for vulnerable groups.” <<> Director Kim said, “If the Korean economy has entered a new level, the framework of perception to view it must also evolve. If you try to decipher the new era with the grammar of the old era, you will miss what is visible and your responses will be off,” adding, “What is needed now is not commentary to calm anxiety, but the insight to face a changed reality with changed eyes.” <<> In response, People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said on Facebook on the 25th, “The economy and people’s livelihoods are reality. They are not a cyberspace that can be explained by typing a few keystrokes.” He criticized, “The correct attitude for a policy chief is to contemplate measures to deal with the crisis rather than deceiving the people with flashy words.” People Power Party Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon also issued a commentary, stating, “The performance of some large corporations should not be packaged as the warmth of the entire South Korean economy. The perception that there is no major problem across the economy just because the nominal growth rate is approaching 10% due to the strong performance of semiconductor and AI companies is a serious distortion of reality.” He added, “The pain of small business owners buckling under loan interest and the struggles of ordinary people sighing over grocery prices cannot be justified as the ‘cost of success.’ This is a typical wordplay and out-of-body rhetoric to hide the government’s incompetence.” <<> Reporter Lee Kyung-mi kmlee@hani.co.kr (김 실장은 지난 24일 페이스북에 글을 올려 “금년 한국경제는 물가상승분을 포함한 명목성장률이 10%에 육박하는 국면에 진입하고 있다. 반도체·인공지능(AI) 분야의 기업실적 폭발이 교역조건을 개선하고 수출단가를 끌어올리면서 기업이익, 임금, 자산가격이 동반 상승하는 흐름이 형성됐다”며 “경제 전반의 가격체계가 한 단계 상향 조정되는 것은 그 자체로 부정적 현상이 아니다. 오히려 장기간 저성장·저물가에 익숙해진 한국경제가 새로운 균형점을 모색하는 과정으로 볼 수 있다”고 말했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Samsung Electronics to Push for Full Internal Use of ChatGPT and Claude ([단독] 삼성전자, 챗GPT·클로드 사내 사용 전면 허용 추진)
item.description:
Samsung Electronics is pursuing a plan to fully allow employees to use generative artificial intelligence (AI) within the company. The company had effectively banned such use due to concerns over external information leaks, but is now shifting its policy as AI utilization emerges as a key factor in enhancing work efficiency and productivity. (삼성전자가 사내에서 직원들의 생성형 인공지능(AI) 사용을 전면 허용하는 방안을 추진한다. 외부 정보 유출 우려로 그동안 이를 사실상 금지해왔지만, 인공지능 활용이 업무 효율과 생산성을 높이는 핵심 요소로 떠오르면서 기존 방침을 바꾼 것으로 풀이된다.)

According to a comprehensive report by *The Hankyoreh* on the 25th, Samsung Electronics' management has recently established this policy. The group's control tower, known as the "Seocho" business support office at Samsung Electronics, is also understood to have agreed to the move. The company plans to announce this policy internally shortly. (25일 한겨레 취재를 종합하면, 삼성전자 경영진은 최근 이런 방침을 세운 것으로 확인됐다. 그룹 컨트롤타워 구실을 하며 이른바 ‘서초’로 불리는 삼성전자 사업지원실도 이에 동의한 것으로 파악됐다. 회사는 조만간 이런 방침을 사내에 공지할 계획이다.)

Currently, Samsung Electronics effectively prohibits the use of external AI models—such as OpenAI's ChatGPT or Anthropic's Claude—on company computers connected to its internal security network. This followed an incident in 2023 where some employees entered internal company information into ChatGPT. The ban was implemented company-wide, primarily in the Device eXperience (DX) division (which handles finished products like smartphones and home appliances), while the Device Solutions (DS) division (semiconductors) allowed limited use only with internal approval. (현재 삼성전자는 자체 보안망에 접속된 회사 컴퓨터로 오픈에이아이(AI)의 챗지피티나 앤트로픽의 클로드 등 외부 인공지능 모델을 이용하는 것을 사실상 금지하고 있다. 앞서 2023년 일부 직원이 회사 내부 정보를 챗지피티에 입력한 일이 계기가 되면서다. 스마트폰·가전 등 완제품사업(DX)부문을 중심으로 전사 차원에서 외부 인공지능 모델을 사용할 수 없도록 차단했고, 반도체사업(DS)부문에 대해서는 사내 결재를 받은 경우에만 제한적으로 쓸 수 있도록 했다.)

The company's proactive shift in its generative AI usage policy appears to stem from a judgment that the "loss" of falling behind in the AI era outweighs the "gain" of enhanced security. This also reflects employee dissatisfaction with the company's own low-utility AI models. Previously, in September of last year, Samsung Electronics CEO and DX division head Noh Tae-moon stated at a press conference, "By 2030, we will utilize AI in 90% of all work areas." In his New Year's address, he also emphasized, "Let's innovate work methods and thinking through AI to increase work speed and productivity." (이런 상황에서 회사가 전향적으로 생성형 인공지능 활용 방침을 바꾼 것은 보안 강화라는 ‘득’보다, 인공지능 시대에 뒤처지는 ‘실’이 더욱 크다고 판단했기 때문으로 보인다. 효용이 떨어지는 자체 인공지능 모델을 향한 직원들의 불만이 큰 점도 고려한 대목으로 풀이된다. 앞서 노태문 삼성전자 대표이사 사장(DX 부문장)은 지난해 9월 기자 간담회에서 “2030년까지 모든 업무 영역의 90%에 인공지능을 활용하겠다”고 공언한 바 있다. 그는 올해 신년사를 통해서도 “인공지능을 활용해 일하는 방식과 사고까지 혁신해 업무 스피드와 생산성을 높여 나가자”고 했다.)

However, Samsung Electronics management has decided to implement its own safety measures for cloud-based AI models connected to external data centers, due to concerns about information leaks. This includes running AI models only on the internal network or imposing restrictions to prevent employees' input from being used to train external AI models. Information classified as national core technology is expected to be excluded from AI use. (다만, 삼성전자 경영진은 외부 데이터센터에 연결된 클라우드 기반의 인공지능 모델은 정보 유출 우려가 있는 만큼, 자체적인 안전장치를 마련하기로 했다. 사내 전산망에서만 인공지능 모델을 구동하거나, 외부 인공지능 모델의 학습에 직원들이 입력한 정보를 가져다 쓰지 못하도록 제한을 두는 방식 등이다. 국가 핵심 기술로 분류되는 정보는 인공지능 사용 범위에서 제외할 것으로 보인다.)

Samsung Electronics employees generally welcome the management's new policy. One employee noted, "It could reduce time spent on tasks like simple document writing and increase overall work efficiency." On the other hand, some voices still raise concerns about information leaks. (삼성전자 임직원들은 경영진의 새 방침을 대체로 환영하는 분위기다. 한 직원은 “단순 문서 작성 업무 등에 들어가는 시간이 줄어들고, 업무 전반의 효율성이 높아질 수 있을 것”이라고 했다. 반면, 일각에선 여전히 정보 유출에 대한 우려를 제기하는 목소리도 나온다.)

As Samsung Electronics, which has maintained a conservative work culture, moves to allow the use of external AI models for work, attention is on whether this will influence other large corporations. This is because Samsung Electronics, with its stability-focused bureaucratic culture, has fired the starting signal for change. Currently, SK Hynix and several other large companies generally prohibit the use of external AI services internally, allowing it only on a limited basis when necessary. (보수적 업무 문화를 유지해온 삼성전자가 외부 인공지능 모델을 업무에 활용할 수 있도록 나서면서, 이런 움직임이 다른 대기업에도 영향을 미칠지 주목된다. 안정에 방점을 둔 관료적인 문화를 가진 삼성전자가 먼저 변화의 신호탄을 쏘아 올렸기 때문이다. 현재 에스케이(SK)하이닉스를 비롯해 여러 대기업들은 사내에서 외부 인공지능 서비스를 이용하는 것을 원칙적으로 금지하고 있으며 필요한 경우에만 제한적으로 허용하고 있다.)

item.title: SK Telecom bounces back to 39% market share in Q1 — will it recover 40% this year? (SKT, 1분기 점유율 39%로 반등…올해 안 40% 회복할까)
item.description:
SK Telecom has recovered a 39% market share in the mobile phone market in the first quarter (January-March) of this year. However, as the company needs to secure at least hundreds of thousands of new subscribers to regain the 40% share it held before last year's hacking incident, attention is focused on whether it can achieve its year-end target. (에스케이(SK)텔레콤이 올해 1분기(1~3월) 휴대전화 시장 점유율 39%대를 회복했다. 다만, 지난해 해킹 사태 이전 수준인 40%대 점유율을 되찾으려면 최소 수십만명의 신규 가입자를 확보해야 하는 상황이어서 올 연말 목표 달성 여부에 관심이 쏠린다.)

According to the Ministry of Science and ICT's "Status of Wired and Wireless Telecommunications Service Subscriptions and Wireless Data Traffic Statistics" released on the 25th, the total number of mobile phone lines in March stood at 57,603,485. Of these, SK Telecom had 22,514,992 lines, recording a market share of 39.09%. This represents an increase of 0.07 percentage points (102,349 lines) compared to the previous month. (25일 과학기술정보통신부의 ‘유·무선통신서비스 가입 현황 및 무선데이터 트래픽 통계’를 보면, 지난 3월 전체 휴대전화 회선 수는 5760만3485개였다. 이 가운데 에스케이텔레콤 회선 수는 2251만4992개로 시장 점유율 39.09%를 기록했다. 전월보다 0.07%포인트(10만2349개) 증가한 수치다.)

SK Telecom's market share fell below 40% for the first time in its history in May of last year due to the fallout from the hacking incident, dropping as low as 38.78% (22,279,838 lines) by December of the same year. However, it rebounded to 39.02% (22,401,390 lines) in January of this year and has maintained the 39% range through February and March. This is interpreted as being influenced by demand for number portability when KT implemented a measure to waive cancellation fees for customers who terminated their services early in January. <<> KT, the second-largest operator, saw its market share drop from 23.74% (13,643,128 lines) in December of last year to 23.32% (13,384,211 lines) in January of this year, as more customers terminated their subscriptions following an incident of unauthorized micropayments exploiting illegal femtocells in the second half of last year. Since then, it has maintained a 23% share through March, showing limited subscriber churn compared to SK Telecom. <<> LG Uplus, which benefited from SK Telecom's hacking incident last year, has remained stable. Its market share from January to March of this year was 19.60% (11,250,027 lines), 19.59% (11,254,917 lines), and 19.54% (11,254,700 lines), respectively, showing little fluctuation. <<> Earlier, SK Telecom announced at its general shareholders' meeting in March that it intended to recover a market share of around 40% by the end of this year. However, considering the market share of 40.41% (23,104,423 lines) in March of last year just before the hacking incident, the industry assesses that there are many hurdles to overcome before achieving a "40% market share," as the company needs a net increase of at least about 500,000 subscribers. <<> Reporter Seon Dam-eun sun@hani.co.kr (에스케이텔레콤의 점유율은 해킹 사태 여파로 지난해 5월 창사 이래 처음 40% 아래로 떨어진 뒤 같은 해 12월 38.78%(2227만9838개)까지 하락했다. 그러나 올해 1월 39.02%(2240만1390개)로 반등한 뒤 2~3월에도 39%대를 유지했다. 지난 1월 케이티(KT)가 서비스 중도 해지 고객에 대한 위약금 면제 조처를 시행하면서 번호이동 수요가 영향을 미친 것으로 풀이된다.)

item.title: From Neighborly Performances and Exhibitions to Startups: 60 Artists Live in One 'Root' (Geuru) (이웃과 공연·전시·창업까지…예술가 60명, 한 ‘그루’에 산다)
item.description:
Media artist Ippuri (34, pseudonym), who primarily works with media facade projects, left her hometown of Gwangju in August 2023 and moved to Seoul, settling into 'Geuru House Seocho,' a social housing complex for artists in Seocho-gu, Seoul. This is a public rental home exclusively for unmarried, homeless artists. It offers a kitchen-separated studio (exclusive area of 19–26 ㎡) with full options including a refrigerator, microwave, and air conditioner. With a deposit of 25 million won and monthly rent of around 500,000 won, the housing cost is less than half of the market rate in the area. (미디어 파사드 작업을 주로 하는 미디어 아티스트 이뿌리(34·활동명)씨는 2023년 8월 고향인 광주에서 상경하면서 서울 서초구에 있는 예술가들의 사회주택 ‘그루하우스 서초’에 보금자리를 마련했다. 이곳은 결혼을 하지 않은 무주택 예술가만 입주할 수 있는 공공임대주택이다. 냉장고, 전자레인지, 에어컨 등 풀옵션이 제공되는 주방분리형 원룸(전용면적 19∼26㎡)인데, 보증금 2500만원에 월세 50만원 수준으로 주거비가 인근 시세의 절반도 안 된다.)

While the affordable rent is an advantage, for Ms. Ippuri, the community among artist neighbors was the most important factor. Indeed, in this complex where 60 artists from different genres and fields—such as classical music, dance, fine arts, comics, video, and theater—live together, artistic collaborations occur frequently. "We've created performances by collaborating with residents, and we've also formed teams to participate in local festivals," said Ms. Ippuri. "We often help each other with what we need for our own work." As she prepares to move out this summer for a larger workspace, Geuru House Seocho has served as an excellent foundation for her. (저렴한 주거비도 이점이지만, 이씨에겐 예술가 이웃들 사이의 커뮤니티가 무엇보다 중요했다. 실제로 클래식 음악, 무용, 미술, 만화, 영상, 연극 등 서로 다른 장르와 분야에서 활동하는 예술가 60명이 모여 사는 이곳에서는 예술 협업이 시시때때로 이뤄진다. 이씨는 “입주민들과 같이 협업해서 공연을 만들기도 하고, 같이 팀을 맺어서 지역 축제에 참여하기도 했다”며 “각자 작업할 때 필요한 걸 서로 도와주는 일도 잦다”고 말했다. 더 넓은 작업 공간이 필요해 올여름 이사를 준비 중인 이씨에게 그루하우스 서초는 훌륭한 밑거름이 됐다.)

On the 20th of last month, The Hankyoreh visited Geuru House Seocho in Seocho-gu, Seoul, which is a representative example of the Korea Land and Housing Corporation (LH) specialized purchase rental housing. Specialized purchase rental housing refers to 'consumer-tailored' public rental homes built from the planning and design stages to meet the needs and characteristics of specific residents, such as youth, the elderly, and people with disabilities. This studio-type housing, a 10-minute walk from Bangbae Station on Subway Line 2 and spanning from the first basement floor to the 11th floor above ground, was also built from the planning and design stages specifically for single-person household artists. The first floor features a community space for small performances and exhibitions, and the rooftop has a lounge for creative activities. Once moved in, residents can live here for up to six years. (지난 20일 한겨레가 찾은 서울 서초구 그루하우스 서초는 한국토지주택공사(LH) 특화형 매입임대주택의 대표 사례다. 특화형 매입임대주택은 기획과 설계 단계부터 청년, 고령층, 장애인 등 특정 입주자의 요구와 특성에 맞춰 지어지는 ‘수요자 맞춤형’ 공공임대주택을 말한다. 지하철 2호선 방배역에서 걸어서 10분 거리의 지하 1층∼지상 11층 규모 원룸형 주택인 이곳도 기획·설계 단계부터 1인 가구 예술가들을 위한 주택으로 지어졌다. 건물 1층에는 작은 공연과 전시가 가능한 커뮤니티 공간이 있고, 옥상에는 창작 활동을 할 수 있는 라운지도 꾸려져 있다. 한번 입주하면 최장 6년 거주할 수 있다.)

Although the resident community wasn't smooth from the start, three years after the initial move-in, it has now successfully settled in. An official from Ibooki, the social enterprise that operates Geuru House Seocho, said, "At first, we also didn't know much about the artists' characteristics, so there was some trial and error, but now the community is active. Residents share both good and bad news in a group chat, communicate, and establish rules." He added, "Activities range from small groups creating rooftop gardens to cases of starting businesses together." Geuru House Seocho selects 20 waitlisted applicants per quarter, and nearly 1,600 people applied, resulting in a competition ratio of 80 to 1. (처음부터 입주자 커뮤니티가 순조로웠던 것은 아니지만, 첫 입주 뒤 3년이 흐른 지금은 성공리에 자리 잡았다. 그루 하우스 서초를 운영하는 사회적기업 아이부키 관계자는 “처음에는 저희도 예술가들 특징을 잘 몰라서 시행착오도 있었지만 이제는 커뮤니티가 활발하다. 입주자들이 단체 카톡방에서 좋은 일이든 나쁜 일이든 함께 공유하면서 소통하고 규칙을 정하기도 한다”며 “옥상에 텃밭을 꾸리는 소모임부터 같이 창업을 하는 경우까지 다양하다”고 말했다. 그루하우스 서초는 분기별로 대기자를 20명씩 뽑는데 여기에만 1600명 가까이 지원해 경쟁률이 80 대 1에 이르렀다.)

The biggest advantage of specialized purchase rental housing is that it provides various residential spaces tailored to the residents, with a community built around them. This diversity is made possible by the collaboration between the private and public sectors. The project proceeds as follows: non-profit corporations or social enterprises, as private operators, freely set a theme for the housing and submit rental housing ideas and design proposals. The Korea Land and Housing Corporation then reviews and selects proposals, entrusting the construction to the selected operator. Since the housing is planned, designed, and built based on the private operator's proposal, and then purchased by the public entity, which re-entrusts its operation and management to the private operator, it differs from general purchase rental housing. (특화형 매입임대주택의 최대 장점은 입주민 맞춤형으로 다양한 주거 공간이 제공되고 이를 중심으로 커뮤니티가 꾸려진다는 것이다. 이러한 다양성이 확보될 수 있는 배경에는 민간과 공공의 합심이 있다. 이 사업은 비영리법인, 사회적기업 등의 민간사업자가 자유롭게 정한 주택 운영 테마에 맞춰 임대주택 아이디어와 설계안을 제출하면 한국토지주택공사가 심사를 거쳐 채택한 뒤 해당 사업자에게 건축을 맡기는 방식으로 진행된다. 민간 사업자의 제안에 따라 주택을 기획·설계·시공하면, 공공이 이를 매입한 뒤 다시 민간 사업자에게 운영·관리를 재위탁하는 식이라, 일반 매입임대주택과는 다르다.)

As of March this year, 78 buildings (2,718 households) of specialized purchase rental housing are in operation in the Seoul metropolitan area alone. 'Haesimdang' in Dobong-gu, Seoul, is the first specialized purchase rental housing for the elderly. This is a community care safety home tailored for seniors, built on the site of an old demolished house, where a total of 21 elderly households live. Applying a housing design for vulnerable groups, it eliminates thresholds and installs safety handrails on stairs and hallways according to the characteristics of the elderly, and has become the first small-scale housing to receive barrier-free environment design certification. Each unit has a safety sensor that automatically detects movement, helping prevent accidents among elderly residents living alone. (특화형 매입임대주택은 올해 3월 기준으로 수도권에만 78개 동(2718가구)이 운영되고 있다. 서울 도봉구에 자리한 ‘해심당’의 경우는 고령자를 위한 특화형 매입임대주택 1호다. 이곳은 기존의 노후주택을 철거한 자리에 새로 지은 어르신 맞춤형 커뮤니티 케어 안심주택으로 노인들만 총 21가구가 살고 있다. 고령자 특성에 맞게 문턱을 없애고 계단과 복도에 안전 손잡이를 설치하는 등 주거 약자형 주택 설계를 적용해, 소규모주택 최초로 무장애 환경 설계 인증도 받았다. 각 호실에는 움직임을 자동으로 감지하는 안심 센서가 있어 홀몸 어르신들의 사고를 예방한다.)

There is also 'Dadareum House,' a specialized purchase rental housing for adults with developmental disabilities. Located in Eunpyeong-gu, Seoul, this is a socially integrated self-reliance support home where people with developmental disabilities, non-disabled youth, and young people preparing for independence live together. It houses 20 people with disabilities and 33 non-disabled residents. Angels Haven, a non-profit specializing in developmental disabilities, participated from the planning and design stages to create a space tailored for people with developmental disabilities. Large shared kitchens and lounges encourage natural communal living among residents, and various programs, including vocational training for people with disabilities, are also conducted. (성인 발달장애인을 위한 특화형 매입임대주택인 ‘다다름하우스’도 있다. 서울 은평구에 있는 이곳은 발달장애인과 비장애청년·자립준비청년들이 함께 살아가는 사회통합형 자립지원주택으로, 장애인 20명과 비장애인 33명이 살고 있다. 발달장애 전문 법인 엔젤스헤이븐이 기획·설계 단계부터 참여해 발달장애인 맞춤형 공간을 마련했다. 커다란 공유주방과 공유라운지를 통해 입주민들 사이의 자연스러운 공동체 생활을 유도하고, 장애인 직업훈련 등 다양한 프로그램도 함께 진행된다.)

'Anam Life' in Seongbuk-gu, Seoul, is a youth-specific type, providing living spaces for young entrepreneurs, creators, and university students. Each room is dormitory-style with a bed and desk, without a kitchen or laundry room. Residents must use shared living rooms, kitchens, and laundry facilities in the basement, but the biggest advantage is the low rent—a deposit of 1 million won and monthly rent of 290,000 to 380,000 won—which is cheaper than the surrounding market rates. Various shared spaces host small groups for study and workshops, and employment and startup support programs for residents and local youth are also active. (서울 성북구에 위치한 ‘안암생활’은 청년 특화형으로, 청년 창업가와 창작가, 대학생을 위한 거주공간이다. 각 방은 침대와 책상이 딸린 기숙사 형태로 주방과 세탁실이 없다. 지하에 공유 거실과 주방, 세탁실을 이용해야 하지만 임대료가 보증금 100만원에 월세 29∼38만원 수준으로 주변 시세보다 저렴하다는 점이 최대 장점이다. 다양한 공유공간에서 스터디·워크숍 등 소모임이 이뤄지고 입주자와 인근 지역 청년을 위한 취업·창업지원 프로그램도 활성화되어 있다.)

This year, the Korea Land and Housing Corporation is also promoting projects to supply approximately 1,000 units of specialized purchase rental housing. Since last month, applications for the first-half private operator selection have been accepted, and 26 proposals (2,729 households) have been received nationwide. After document screening in June and comprehensive review in July, selected projects will undergo evaluations such as appraisals around October, followed by contract signing. (올해도 한국토지주택공사는 특화형 매입임대주택 약 1천가구 공급을 위한 사업을 추진한다. 지난달부터 상반기 특화형 매입임대주택 민간사업자 공모 신청을 받았는데, 전국에서 26건(2729가구)의 제안이 접수됐다. 6월 서류심사와 7월 종합심사를 거쳐 선정될 물건은 오는 10월 중에 감정평가 등을 거쳐 약정체결을 진행할 계획이다.)

In particular, starting from this selection, various system improvements have been made to filter out poorly performing operating agencies. To strengthen financial stability, a new inspection and evaluation item related to resident deposits was introduced. Additionally, when initially selecting an operating agency, points are deducted—effectively leading to disqualification—for those with a history of overdue rent for more than three months within a year or a history of contract termination or withdrawal during the housing rental operation. (특히 이번 공모부터는 부실 운영기관을 걸러내기 위한 각종 제도 개선도 이뤄졌다. 재무 안정성 강화를 위해 입주자 보증금 관련 점검평가 항목을 신설했다. 최초 운영기관 선정 시에도 1년 내 3개월 이상 임대료 체납 이력이 있거나 주택 임대 운영 도중 계약해지나 중도 포기한 이력이 있는 경우는 감점이 적용돼 사실상 탈락하도록 개선했다.)

Lee Ji-hye, Staff Reporter godot@hani.co.kr (이지혜 기자 godot@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Samsung Electronics faces internal imbalance and shareholder lawsuits… backlash over ‘hundred-million-won bonuses’ (삼성전자, 조직 내 불균형·주주 소송…‘억대 성과급’ 후폭풍)
item.description:
Although Samsung Electronics’ labor and management, which had been in conflict over the distribution of bonuses, reached an agreement on the 20th, the backlash has been severe. Concerns range from the company’s future competitiveness to shareholder movements threatening to file lawsuits seeking to invalidate the bonuses, with the layers of criticism becoming increasingly diverse. (성과급 배분 방식을 두고 갈등을 빚어온 삼성전자 노사가 지난 20일 합의를 이뤄냈지만, 후폭풍이 거세다. 회사의 미래 경쟁력을 우려하는 목소리에서부터 성과급 무효 소송을 내겠다는 주주들 움직임까지 문제 제기의 층위도 다양해지고 있다.)

The core of the provisional labor-management agreement at Samsung Electronics is to establish a temporary ‘special management performance bonus’ for employees in the semiconductor business (DS) division, which has been enjoying a memory supercycle, to be paid additionally over the next 10 years beyond existing bonuses. Starting early next year, the total bonuses these employees are expected to receive are projected to reach hundreds of millions of won per person. (삼성전자 노사 잠정 합의안의 핵심은 메모리 슈퍼사이클(초호황)을 맞은 반도체사업(DS)부문 직원들에게 기존 성과급에 더해, 향후 10년간 한시적으로 ‘특별 경영 성과급’을 신설해 추가로 지급하겠다는 것이다. 당장 내년 초에 이들이 받을 전체 성과급은 1명당 수억원에 이를 것으로 전망된다.)

Will attrition decrease? (퇴사자 줄어들까? )

Following this labor-management agreement, there is talk both inside and outside Samsung Electronics that the issue of talent outflow may be partially resolved. The union had argued that opaque compensation was causing serious talent leakage, with internal staff moving to competitors. In fact, Samsung Electronics’ turnover rate (ratio of retirees to total employees) stood at 10.1% as of 2024, nearly eight times that of SK Hynix (1.3%). Of course, unlike Hynix, which only counts domestic employees, Samsung’s turnover rate includes overseas offices where sales and marketing staff resign more frequently, so direct comparison is difficult. However, it’s undeniable that the spread of the ‘Samsung Electronics semiconductor crisis theory’ until early last year caused significant unrest among semiconductor division employees. (이번 노사 합의로 삼성전자 안팎에서는 인재 유출 문제가 일부 해소될 가능성이 커졌다는 얘기가 나온다. 그동안 노조는 성과급 제도화를 요구하며 불투명한 보상 탓에 내부 인재가 경쟁사로 이직하는 등 인재 유출이 심각하다고 주장해왔다. 실제로 삼성전자의 퇴직률(전체 임직원 수 대비 퇴직자 수 비율)은 2024년 기준 10.1%로, 에스케이(SK)하이닉스(1.3%)의 8배 가까이 된다. 물론 삼성전자의 퇴직률은 국내 임직원만 집계한 하이닉스와 달리 영업·마케팅직 이직자가 많은 해외 사업장을 포함한 것이어서 두 수치를 단순 비교하긴 어려우나, 지난해 초까지 ‘삼성전자 반도체 위기론’이 확산하며 반도체 부문 직원들의 동요가 컸던 것은 사실이다.)

Can semiconductor competitiveness recover? (반도체 경쟁력 회복은? )

However, the problem is that the special bonuses are concentrated within the memory business division of the semiconductor sector. Even setting aside employees in the finished goods business (DX) division, such as smartphones and home appliances, who receive no bonuses, employees in the semiconductor division’s system LSI and foundry businesses will only receive about one-third of the bonuses (based on this year’s levels) compared to those in the memory business division. By stitching up the labor-management conflict, Samsung Electronics now faces a new challenge: resolving internal imbalance and feelings of alienation to restore semiconductor competitiveness. (다만, 문제는 특별 성과급이 반도체 부문 내에서도 메모리 사업부에 집중된다는 점이다. 성과급을 받지 못하는 스마트폰·가전 등 완제품사업(DX) 부문 직원들을 차지하고서라도, 반도체 부문의 시스템반도체 설계(시스템LSI) 및 파운드리(반도체 수탁생산) 사업부 직원들은 메모리 사업부 직원의 3분의 1 수준(올해 치 기준)의 성과급만 받게 된다. 노사 갈등 국면을 봉합한 삼성전자가 반도체 경쟁력을 회복하기 위해선 조직 내 불균형과 소외감을 해결해야 하는 새로운 과제를 안게 된 것이다.)

Actual take-home bonuses linked to stock price (주가에 연동된 성과급 실수령액)

Of course, the actual amount of bonuses received by memory division employees could shrink depending on market conditions and stock price fluctuations. This is because the entire special bonus is to be paid in ‘stocks’. These stocks are conditionally granted based on the stock price at the time of distribution. Two-thirds of the total shares will be subject to a lock-up period of 1-2 years during which they cannot be sold, and if the semiconductor division’s annual operating profit falls short of 200 trillion won (by 2028), none of the bonus stocks will be paid. If Samsung Electronics’ current stock price, hovering near 300,000 won per share, declines due to future semiconductor cycles, the after-tax bonuses that employees actually receive could be less than expected, given the restrictions on selling shares. (물론 메모리 사업부 직원들이 받는 성과급 실수령액은 업황과 주가 변동에 따라 줄어들 여지도 있다. 특별 성과급 전액을 ‘주식’으로 받기로 했기 때문이다. 이 주식은 지급 시점의 주가를 반영해 조건부로 지급한다. 전체 주식의 3분의 2는 1~2년간 매각할 수 없는 보호 예수를 적용하고, 반도체 부문 영업이익이 연간 200조원(2028년까지)을 미달하면 한 푼도 받을 수 없다. 현재 주당 30만원에 육박하는 삼성전자 주가가 향후 반도체 사이클에 따라 꺾이게 되면, 주식 매도가 제한된 직원들이 실제 손에 쥘 세후 성과급은 기대보다 줄어들 가능성도 있다.)

Will shareholder lawsuits become an issue? (주주 소송 문제될까? )

Meanwhile, Samsung Electronics shareholder groups have announced plans to sue, arguing that the payment of ultra-high bonuses under this labor-management agreement constitutes “a violation of directors’ duty of loyalty to shareholders and breach of trust in business.” Their rationale is that the directors, through their bonus decisions, have infringed on shareholders’ ‘right to claim residual property distribution’ that would otherwise come through dividends. (한편, 삼성전자 주주 단체들은 이번 노사 합의에 따른 초고액 성과급 지급이 “삼성전자 이사의 주주 충실 의무 위반이자 업무상 배임”이라며 소송을 예고하고 있다. 이사들이 성과급 결정을 통해 주주들이 배당을 통해 가져갈 ‘잔여 재산 분배 청구권’을 침해했다는 이유에서다.)

However, legal circles suggest that the risk of such lawsuits materializing is not significant. This is because the principle of ‘residual property distribution’ stipulated in the current Commercial Act merely means that, upon corporate dissolution, after settling debts to creditors, the remaining assets should be distributed to shareholders. One capital market specialist lawyer stated, “It’s questionable whether Samsung Electronics directors can be held liable for damages for their decision being illegal in procedural or substantive terms.” (그러나 법조계를 중심으로 이런 소송 위험이 현실화할 가능성은 크지 않다는 목소리가 나온다. 현행 상법에 명시된 ‘잔여 재산 분배의 원칙’은 회사 청산 때 채권자 변제를 마치고 남은 재산을 주주들에게 분배해야 한다는 의미에 그친다는 이유에서다. 한 자본시장 전문 변호사는 “삼성전자 이사들을 대상으로 그들의 의사 결정이 절차적, 실질적 측면에서 위법하다며 손해 배상 책임을 물을 수 있는지 의문”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Park Jong-oh pjo2@hani.co.kr (박종오 기자 pjo2@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Abandoning the Lowest-Credit Borrowers: The Korea Inclusive Finance Agency Forgets Its Mission (최저신용자 외면…본분 잊은 서민금융진흥원)
item.description:
Last year, the support proportion for debtors in the bottom 10% credit score bracket by the Korea Inclusive Finance Agency (KIFA), the nation's leading policy-based microfinance institution, fell by 17 percentage points over two years. As the Yoon Suk Yeol administration promotes "inclusive finance" as a core financial policy principle, there are calls to reform the supply structure to enhance financial access for low-credit vulnerable borrowers. (지난해 국내 대표 정책서민금융 기관인 서민금융진흥원(서금원)의 신용점수 하위 10% 채무자 지원 비중이 2년 만에 17%포인트 하락한 것으로 나타났다. 이재명 정부가 ‘포용금융’을 핵심 금융정책 기조로 내세우고 있는 가운데 저신용 취약 차주의 금융 접근성을 높이기 위해 공급 구조를 손봐야 한다는 지적이 나온다.)

According to a report titled "Financial Reform Measures such as Inclusive Finance" published by the National Assembly Budget Office (NABO) on the 25th, the proportion of loans and guarantees provided by KIFA to those in the bottom 10% credit score bracket was 49.1% (3.349 trillion won) last year. This marks a 17.0 percentage point decline over two years from 66.1% (4.494 trillion won) in 2023, with the amount also decreasing by over 1 trillion won. Conversely, the proportion for those above the bottom 20% credit score bracket rose significantly from 23.3% (1.5872 trillion won) in 2023 to 40.1% (2.7344 trillion won) last year. The bottom 20% threshold is based on a KCB credit score of 700 points. (25일 국회예산정책처(예정처)가 펴낸 ‘포용적 금융 등 금융개혁 방안’ 보고서를 보면, 지난해 서금원의 보증·융자 실적 가운데 신용점수 하위 10% 비중은 49.1%(3조3490억원)로 집계됐다. 2023년 66.1%(4조4940억원)에 견줘 2년 만에 17.0%포인트 하락했고 금액도 1조원 넘게 줄었다. 반면 신용점수 하위 20%를 넘는 비중은 2023년 23.3%(1조5872억원)에서 지난해 40.1%(2조7344억원)로 크게 상승했다. 하위 20%는 케이시비(KCB) 신용점수 700점이 기준이다.)

This is attributed to the insufficient supply of "guaranteed loans," which constitute the bulk of policy-based microfinance, to the lowest credit score targets. Policy-based microfinance products are largely divided into direct loans (advances), where KIFA directly supplies funds, and guaranteed loans, where KIFA guarantees over 90% of the loan amount and private financial companies provide the funds. Last year, the supply volumes for each method were 132.6 billion won and 6.6855 trillion won, respectively, with guaranteed loans overwhelmingly dominant. While the proportion supplied to the bottom 10% credit score bracket reached 91.4% for direct loans, it was only 48.3% for guaranteed loans, which have a far larger volume. (이는 정책서민금융 공급의 대부분을 차지하는 ‘보증부 대출’이 최저 신용점수 대상에게 충분하게 공급되지 못한 결과다. 정책서민금융 상품은 크게 서금원이 직접 자금을 공급하는 직접대출(융자)과 서금원이 대출금의 90% 이상을 보증하고 민간 금융회사가 자금을 공급하는 보증부 대출로 나뉜다. 지난해 각 방식의 공급 규모는 1326억원, 6조6855억원으로 보증부 대출이 압도적으로 많다. 신용점수 하위 10%에게 제공한 비중을 보면 직접대출 공급 비중은 91.4%에 이르지만, 금액이 훨씬 많은 보증부 대출은 48.3%에 그쳤다.)

The NABO pointed out, "Looking at the target support for each KIFA program, criteria such as annual income of 35 million won or less were established regardless of credit score, which seems intended to ensure a certain level of debt repayment capacity. However, as a result, it appears to have expanded support more toward mid-credit borrowers (with stable income) rather than low-credit borrowers." It added, "There is a need to improve the current support targets and loan criteria to strengthen loans and guarantees for low-credit borrowers." (예정처는 “서금원의 사업별 지원 대상을 보면 신용점수와 무관하게 연 소득 3500만원 이하 등 기준을 설정했는데 이는 일정 수준의 채무 상환 능력을 담보하기 위한 것으로 보이나, 결과적으로 저신용자보다는 (일정한 소득이 있는) 중신용자 이상에게 지원이 확대되는 결과를 초래한 것으로 보인다”며 “현재 지원 대상과 대출 기준을 개선해 저신용자에 대한 융자와 보증을 강화할 필요가 있다”고 지적했다.)

A KIFA official stated, "Policy financial products can be used if you meet either low-credit or low-income criteria. If the proportion of low-credit borrowers has decreased, it is possible that the proportion of low-income borrowers has increased." They added, "It seems that the 'credit score inflation' trend, where overall credit scores are rising, along with repayment capacity assessments, have had a combined effect." (서금원 관계자는 “정책금융 상품은 저신용 또는 저소득 기준 가운데 하나만 충족해도 이용할 수 있다. 저신용자 비중이 줄었다면 저소득자 비중이 늘었을 가능성도 있다”며 “전반적인 신용점수가 상승하는 ‘신용점수 인플레이션’ 흐름과 상환 능력 평가 등이 복합적으로 작용한 것으로 보인다”고 말했다.)

Reporter An Tae-ho eco@hani.co.kr (안태호 기자 eco@hani.co.kr)
